questions.q: A comprehensive job intake form (job card) designed to avoid subsequent business disputes should ideally capture all of the following vital pieces of information, EXCEPT:
options: The device's unique 15-digit IMEI or manufacturer Serial Number.
A detailed written assessment of pre-existing housing scratches and screen dents.
The customer's personal bank routing details or ATM pin code.
The customer's explicit signature legally authorizing the diagnostic process.
questions.explain: Banking details or financial pin codes are highly private and completely irrelevant to assessing or repairing mobile phone hardware/software issues. Requesting them creates massive liability and destroys customer trust.

questions.q: What crucial piece of written text included on a final repair receipt best shields the workshop owner from ambiguous long-term financial liability after a phone is successfully returned to a customer?
options: A legally binding, clearly demarcated 'limited warranty' period stating conditions exclusively for the specific replaced part.
A generalized, friendly 'Thank You For Your Business' message in large font.
The lead technician's personal home address and direct phone number.
The original historical retail price of the phone when it was brand new.
questions.explain: A strict written warranty clause on the receipt (e.g., '30 days limited warranty on the installed LCD screen only; excludes subsequent water or drop damage') legally boundaries the repair shop's liability if the device independently fails later.
